description: Cloudflare's AI services are provided by a web-infrastructure company headquartered in San Francisco, California.
residency_notes: Workers AI runs on Cloudflare's global network. Cloudflare says Workers AI Customer Content is not used for training and may be stored when the customer explicitly uses a Cloudflare storage service; the public API docs do not promise a fixed data region or a named ZDR control. Select models may use in-memory prompt caching.
prompt_training_notes: Cloudflare says it does not use Workers AI customer content to train AI models or improve Cloudflare or third-party services unless it receives explicit consent.

sources.notes: Cloudflare's official About page identifies San Francisco as its headquarters and lists 101 Townsend St., San Francisco, CA 94107.
Official Workers AI OpenAI-compatible endpoint, account scope, authentication, and supported API surfaces.

verification.notes: Official Workers AI documentation confirms the account-scoped OpenAI-compatible base URL, bearer API-token authentication, and Chat Completions support.
